preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of roads m must be less than the number of cities n.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in query_x)
preconditions.description: Each city index xi in the queries must be within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= yi <= n for yi in query_y)
preconditions.description: Each city index yi in the queries must be within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the longest path in the region containing city xi.

postconditions.expression: any(city in merged_region for city in [xi, yi])
postconditions.description: After merging, the cities xi and yi must belong to the same region.
